instruction: Query the OQMD database for Ce-O binary compounds with band_gap > 0 (element_set=Ce,O AND ntypes=2 AND band_gap>0) using limit=10. Sort the returned results by band_gap descending in Python. Save the total count (data_available from API metadata) and the entry with the largest band_gap (entry_id/name/band_gap/delta_e/stability/spacegroup) to 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\setup\output_result\oqmd\oqmd_task_18.txt'. Use the OQMD REST API directly with the `requests` library (endpoint: https://oqmd.org/oqmdapi/formationenergy), do NOT use qmpy_rester.
